standard: Field Assembly Record Standard 1.2, §8 market records; see PROVENANCE.md
notes: Numbers computed from run 2026-10-18T144956Z. The BLS PPI and CPI series carry September 2026. Prose not yet written. Gaps in this month's figures: the CME Grade AA butter weekly average and Friday close carry no year-over-year comparison, because Dairy Market News reprints one week per report and this record accumulates the series a week at a time. The shell egg prices from AMS report 2848, week ending 2026-10-17, carry no year-over-year comparison either: that report states the current and prior week only, and the prior-week figure is shown as the report states it. The NASS average-layers and table-egg-production figures are for 2026-08, the newest month published, and carry no two-year comparison. The weekly egg market overview is retained and not parsed, so it contributes no figure. Publication gated by FA-D-20260923-01 as amended by FA-D-20260923-02 and FA-D-20260923-04.
